name: rendr-live-demos
description: Three sizes of interactive Rendr demo — bench, medium, mini — as React components. Compositions are supplied by the host.
//rendr-web: Not a package dependency: four files import the runtime by relative path (`../rendr-web/...`), so this folder expects `rendr-web/` as a SIBLING directory. Copy both, keep them adjacent. See README.md — the alternative, a bare `rendr-web` specifier, would need an alias or a workspace in every consuming project, which is more setup than dropping in two folders.
